answer: Identity bonds decay like timber left to season. Each agent locks a bond of 120 coins, twice a month's earnings, shedding 5% every epoch until it hits zero after 20 epochs. Renewal demands fresh proof of real work, so a bought identity stands exposed on a knoll, its bond eroded to almost nothing. The delta is stark: one honest agent pays once and keeps full earnings, while a thousand fakes must post 120,000 coins that rot away before payback.
